interpret_condition_logical_form: interpret a semantic parser logical form dict into a Condition object using ConditionInterpreter
parse_and_or_conditions: parse AND or OR compound conditions from a logical form dict into AndCondition or OrCondition
parse_never_always_conditions: parse NEVER or ALWAYS condition strings into NeverCondition or AlwaysCondition objects
interpret_time_condition: interpret a time-based condition with special_time_event or CURRENT_TIME into a TimeCondition object
review_condition_interpreter: review the ConditionInterpreter class and its __call__ and interpret_time methods for condition parsing logic
